archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Precision) mixed with Tactical Military

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large hero texts, bold statement titles

body.usage: Body copy, descriptions, standard form labels

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for a 'Technical/Tactical' look. Container border-collapse style with subtle right/bottom borders (border-border/40). Flat Solid surfaces. No glassmorphism as it makes things look too soft.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on dark backgrounds to give a gritty, tactical feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes, sharp edges. No large border-radius (max 4px or 0px for brutalist tactical feel).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights or sharp geometric shadows if any.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Grid lines illuminating, accent color highlights, sharp transforms (e.g., -translate-y-1 with harsh drop shadow).

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24) to let the typography and high-contrast imagery breathe. High density only in admin dashboard.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris) for marketing pages. Asymmetry, Visual Tension.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned for all serious/tactical data, avoiding center-everything. Asymmetrical balance.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal on load. Use framer-motion with delay staggering.
motion.interactions: Hover states with tactical crosshairs or grid line highlights. Subtle parallax on hero background.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for 'Nothing is Impossible to a Willing Mind' or '360 DEGREE SECURE' running across the background. Use react-fast-marquee.

component_instructions.navigation: Solid background (Deep Obsidian #0A0A0A) with bottom border (1px border-white/10). Logo is text-based '360 DEGREE SECURE' in Bebas Neue. Desktop must show links, NO hamburger.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#FFC107] text-black hover:bg-[#EAA221]. Secondary: transparent with 1px border-white/20 hover:border-[#FFC107] hover:text-[#FFC107]. Include subtle crosshair or line animations on hover.
component_instructions.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI forms. Sharp inputs, no rounded corners (rounded-none). Focus ring in amber/gold. Labels in uppercase tracking-wide.
component_instructions.cards: Cardless look or sharp rectangular blocks with subtle border (border-white/10). Background #151515.
component_instructions.tabs: Custom Shadcn tabs. Active state gets bottom border of amber, sharp transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds meets APCA standards. Amber on black is highly visible, but ensure gray text (#A0A0A5) is legible.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='enquiry-submit-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container in index.css / App.css.
Create depth through z-index and border styling, not soft shadows.
Use Phosphor icons (bold or duotone) for tactical feel.
No generic AI emojis. Absolutely forbidden.
Strictly adhere to the dark tactical theme: #0A0A0A base, #FFC107 accent.
Ensure 'Bebas Neue' is imported and used for all major headings. Do not fallback to standard sans if possible.
Use Sonner for toasts (sharp edged customization).
